claim: The principle: every interface is understood as something — the picture is not optional, you only choose whether it is accidental; and Four moves: make it legible before it is lovely, since juice past a middle amount stops meaning anything.

pieces.section: Four moves the direction asks for
pieces.what: One compressor, one signal, a juice slider: at low juice the vessel narrows exactly with gain; turned up, the shake and sparkle bury which motion means gain. The reader tries to read gain reduction at each setting. Tests the inverted U.

pieces.section: The principle: every interface is understood *as* something
pieces.what: The same control drawn three ways (plain knob, vessel, thing with mass) on one engine; the reader is asked what each one wants them to do before touching it.
